name: Cipher Digital Inc. (formerly Cipher Mining Inc.)
blurb: Cipher Digital (originally Cipher Mining) began as an industrial-scale bitcoin miner and pivoted aggressively toward AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. The company rebranded in February 2026 to reflect its strategic transformation away from cryptocurrency toward hyperscaler data-centre hosting, leveraging its power-dense facilities and existing infrastructure relationships.
recent: Cipher secured a 15-year, 300-megawatt lease with Amazon Web Services estimated at approximately $5.5 billion in contract value, and a 10-year, 300-megawatt lease with Fluidstack and Google. The company now holds 600 megawatts of contracted HPC capacity. Q1 2026 bitcoin mining revenue was $34.8 million while the company absorbed a wider net loss of $114.3 million as it funds the HPC build-out. Stock rose roughly 300% over the trailing twelve months through mid-2025 before the HPC pivot announcement triggered a near-term sell-off on dilution concerns.
